training_stack: mjlab 1.3.0 (MuJoCo Warp), PPO via RSL-RL, task code in dillonfaulk/microduck_rl (fork-local, not upstream)

training.num_envs_note: 4096 would need ~22 GB; 2048 peaked at 11.8 GB on a 16 GB card, 1.6 s/iteration
training.robot_model: all-collisions (as VelStand and the mission), not BallKick's ground-contact model
training.targets: per episode, start yaw frame: 65% radius 0-80 mm, 35% 80-250 mm; half the bearings in a +-45 deg forward cone, half all-around; heading +-15 deg; 10% exact zero (hold still)
training.ball: 70% of episodes: at the BallKick spot (0.09, -0.042) +-15 mm relative to the TARGET stance, unless it would overlap the start footprint; moving it > 1 cm terminates the episode (-20)
training.start: standing, HOME joints +-0.08 rad, +-5 deg roll/pitch
training.lineage: run 1 (chunk1, from scratch) stopped at 1253: model_1000 placed to 4.5 mm but arrived in a ~30-36 deg hip/knee crouch and the kick never fired (0/60 missions). Run 2 (chunk2_pose) = plain resume from run 1 model_1250 with arrival-posture terms (legs at HOME within 30 mm of the target) -> 3999.

contract.obs_layout: same as VelStand: ang_vel 0:3, projected_gravity 3:6, joint_pos_rel 6:20, joint_vel 20:34, last_action 34:48, command 48:61
contract.command: slots 48:51 = REMAINING offset to the target pose in the trunk's current yaw frame [dx m (forward), dy m (left), dyaw rad]; recomputed every tick; slots 51:61 (head/body) = 0. Trained range |(dx,dy)| <= 0.25 m, |dyaw| <= 15 deg.
contract.command_note: VelStand reads slots 48:51 as a velocity; this policy reads them as an offset. The supervisor picks the ONNX, so it fills the slots to match.
contract.obs_normalization: empirical normalizer BAKED INTO the ONNX (exported with microduck_rl scripts/export.py) -- feed raw observations
contract.use: hard swap from VelStand inside ~0.25 m of the target pose; swap out (to the kick) once within 12 mm / 3 deg and still for 0.5 s

measured_results_model_3999.placement_battery_velstand_start_50: kick-ready 50/50; position error median 4.8 mm (worst 9.4); heading 0.46 deg; worst leg joint vs HOME median 3.0 deg (worst 4.4); ball struck 0/46; falls 0
measured_results_model_3999.with_ball_vs_ball_free: kick-ready 130/132 with a ball, 18/18 ball-free (all three batteries)
measured_results_model_3999.missions_headless_2x30: 60/60 kicked, approach_mode precision in 60/60 (0 pulse fallbacks), 0 bumped balls, 0 falls, median ~17-19 s per mission (pulse aligner baseline: 57/60, 3 bumps, ~25 s)
measured_results_model_3999.missions_viewer_30: Dillon's live viewer run: 30/30 kicked, all precision, 0 pulses, 0 falls (run twice, deterministic, identical)
measured_results_model_3999.kick_ready_definition: within 12 mm and 3 deg of the target, front-back foot stagger < 10 mm, still for the last 0.5 s, every leg joint within 0.10 rad of HOME, ball not moved, no fall

known_weaknesses: SIM ONLY -- never run on the physical robot
ground-truth pose and ball position in sim; no odometry or vision yet
the mission pivots with VelStand first when the heading is > 8 deg off (the step policy trained on +-15 deg)
feet end ~5 mm behind HOME relative to the trunk; compensated in the mission by a +10 mm stance target shift (policy unchanged)
BallKick v1's ~18 deg left drift is compensated by a -17.9 deg mission aim offset (right foot only)

mission_calibrations_2026-11-11.note: supervisor constants in kick_mission.py; no ONNX, reward or training change; measured in order (stance, then aim) on the v1 scenarios, seeds 0+1, 60 missions

PRECISE_STANCE_SHIFT_M.applies_to: precision path only (pulse fallback keeps its own target)
PRECISE_STANCE_SHIFT_M.pre: ball +10.2 mm farther than trained from the kicking foot (median); roll median 1.01 m (0.76-1.30)
PRECISE_STANCE_SHIFT_M.post: ball +0.25 mm; roll median 1.20 m (1.02-1.38); 60/60 kicked, 0 bumps, 0 falls; 59/60 rolled farther, 1 rolled 3.4 cm less, none below 0.76 m

KICK_AIM_OFFSET.sign: +yaw is LEFT (CCW); kick_dir_err_deg > 0 = ball left of intended; offset negative = aim right
KICK_AIM_OFFSET.pre: drift +17.9 deg median (std 1.7, IQR 16.5-19.1, flat across ball distance) from the +10 mm stance; +15.5 deg from the v1 stance
KICK_AIM_OFFSET.post_headless: +0.1 deg median (-3.8..+4.0); roll 1.20 m; 60/60 kicked, 0 bumps, 0 falls
KICK_AIM_OFFSET.post_viewer: Dillon's run, 30/30 kicked, all precision, 0 falls; +0.5 deg median (-5..+3), 28/30 within 2 deg; roll 1.19 m (1.10-1.31)
KICK_AIM_OFFSET.scope: right foot (BallKick v1 ts0.25 model_1000) only
